# Toronto Millworks

> Custom millwork, cabinetry and interior renovation for Toronto and the GTA. We measure on site, draw every piece, build it in our own shop at 2585 Drew Rd Unit 7, Mississauga, ON L4T 1G1, then install and finish it. Residential and commercial work within about 120 km of the shop.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/): Custom millwork, cabinetry and interior renovation for Toronto and the GTA.
- [Services](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/services/): The seven things we make.
- [Projects](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/projects/): A commercial bar fit-out, shell to finished room, and residential panelling.
- [About](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/about/): One shop that measures, draws, builds and installs.
- [Contact](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/contact/): Request a measured quote.
- [FAQ](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/faq/): Cost, timing, process, materials and service area.
- [Service areas](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/service-areas/): Every town within 120 km of the shop.
- [Guides](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/guides/): Cost, materials, finishes and planning.

## Services

- [Custom Kitchens](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/services/custom-kitchens/): Custom kitchen cabinets for Toronto and GTA homes, measured on site, drawn to scale, built in our Mississauga shop and installed by one team.
- [Cabinetry & Built-Ins](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/services/cabinetry-and-built-ins/): Custom built-in cabinetry for Toronto and GTA homes: media walls, libraries, wardrobes, mudrooms and vanities, designed around the room.
- [Architectural Millwork](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/services/architectural-millwork/): Architectural millwork for Toronto and the GTA: wall panelling, coffered ceilings, crown moulding, casings and stairs, with profiles milled to match.
- [Restaurant & Bar Millwork](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/services/restaurant-and-bar-millwork/): Custom bars, back bars, service counters and banquettes for restaurants, bars and cafes across the GTA, shop drawn and installed to your schedule.
- [Office Millwork](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/services/office-millwork/): Custom office millwork across Toronto and the GTA: reception desks, boardroom credenzas, staff kitchens and storage walls, built in our shop.
- [Commercial Fit-Outs](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/services/commercial-fit-outs/): Commercial millwork packages for contractors, designers and owners across the GTA: shop drawings, fabrication and install for retail and hospitality.
- [Interior Renovation](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/services/interior-renovation/): Millwork-led interior renovation for Toronto and GTA homes: kitchens, bathrooms, basements and whole rooms, with the joinery built in our shop.

## Guides

- [How custom millwork is made](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/guides/how-custom-millwork-is-made/): A step by step guide to how custom millwork is made: the site measure, shop drawings, milling, finishing, dry fitting and installation.
- [What affects the cost of custom cabinetry](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/guides/custom-cabinetry-cost/): The factors that decide what custom cabinetry costs: size, materials, finish, door style, interiors, hardware and site conditions, and how to plan for them.
- [Paint-grade vs stain-grade millwork](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/guides/paint-grade-vs-stain-grade-millwork/): Paint-grade and stain-grade millwork compared: the materials each uses, how they are built and finished, how they age, and where each one belongs.
- [Choosing wood for custom cabinetry](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/guides/choosing-wood-for-cabinetry/): A practical guide to wood for custom cabinetry: white oak, walnut, maple, cherry, ash and poplar, plus plywood, MDF and veneer, and where each belongs.
- [Custom vs semi-custom vs stock cabinets](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/guides/custom-vs-semi-custom-vs-stock-cabinets/): Custom, semi-custom and stock cabinets compared on fit, materials, choice, lead time and cost, with an honest look at when each is the right call.
- [Planning millwork for a restaurant or bar](https://toronto-millworks.vercel.app/guides/planning-restaurant-bar-millwork/): How to plan restaurant and bar millwork: when to involve the millworker, equipment schedules, shop drawings, durable finishes and the install window.
